name: Colombo to Yokosuka, Strait of Malacca denied
purpose: A move from the Indian Ocean to Japan. With no areas, the best route goes through the Strait of Malacca and the Luzon Strait. A 120 nm area of denial over the Strait of Malacca sends the route south of Sumatra and through the Sunda Strait, the nearest way past the Indonesian archipelago.
